summary.name: SummonOS
summary.one_liner: A native macOS 15+ menu bar app and CLI that gives coding agents live Mac context over MCP and snapshots supported settings changes so they can be undone.
use_cases: Connect a coding agent to live Mac context
Preview settings changes with a dry run before applying
Undo supported Mac settings changes via checkpoints
Set up permissions and an agent on a new Mac
Build a native Swift macOS app with templates
summary.what_it_does: The page describes SummonOS as a native Swift app for macOS 15 and later, with a menu bar app and a command-line tool (commands shown include summon context, summon connect --dry-run, and summon checkpoint list). It gives coding agents live Mac context over MCP. It lets you preview a connection with a dry run and snapshots supported settings changes so they can be reverted. The site also offers a field guide covering setup, a toolkit overview, and design notes and architecture documentation. The page lists version 0.2.5 as a preview.
notable: Live Mac context for agents over MCP
Checkpoints snapshot supported settings changes so they can be undone
Dry-run option for connecting agents via summon connect
Listed in awesome-mac as open source, freeware, native app
caveats: Experimental software; version 0.2.5 is a preview
Checkpoints are not a full-system backup
Only supported settings can be checkpointed and reverted
